about_the_game:
Get your first taste of Monstabox in this action-packed demo!

Choose a monster, customize your Monstabox with spells, and dive into fast-paced 1v1 tactical battles. In just 3 minutes per match, you’ll experience thrilling combos, clever traps, and heart-racing comebacks. Then tweak your loadout and jump right back in.

This demo includes:

✔ Online & local battles
✔ Quick Match and private rooms
✔ Multiple monsters and spells to try
✔ Full access to Monstabox’s unique Star-based win condition

The game is still in development, so if you see anything strange, broken, or hilariously wrong, please let us know! We’re working hard to make Monstabox the best it can be.

Join our Discord community!

Suggest new monsters, spells, or mechanics. We love feedback and seriously consider even the most out-there ideas.

short_description: Monstabox: A turn-based 1v1 battle game mixing strategy & action. Choose monsters, cast spells, roll to attack, and unleash ultimates. Win by securing the Star after KOing your opponent. Play cross-platform & compete worldwide!
